name: Bootstrap HII Agent Harness
description: Install and verify the portable Rhino, Grasshopper MCP, ComfyUI, Codex, and Claude harness package.
script: cd {root} && python3 -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate && pip install -U pip setuptools wheel && pip install -e . && PYTHONPATH={root}/src python3 -m hii_agent_harness doctor
outputs: Installed harness environment with doctor output
